mapper.select: SELECT s.answered_count, s.correct_count, s.accuracy, s.mastery, s.exam_count, s.best_score FROM stat_user_subject s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.subject_id = #{subjectId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stat_daily WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND answered_count > 0
SELECT stat_date, answered_count, correct_count, duration_sec FROM stat_daily WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stat_date = #{statDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.user_id, s.subject_id, s.outline_id, s.answered_count, s.correct_count, s.accuracy, s.mastery, s.last_answered_at FROM stat_user_outline s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.subject_id = #{subjectId} LIMIT #{limit}
